app.notes: SubMiner is an Electron mpv overlay; its browser UI is the stats dashboard (stats/, Vite+React) served by the app's own Hono stats server (src/core/services/stats-server.ts) over the immersion-tracker SQLite DB. .ui-capture/server.ts mirrors src/stats-daemon-runner.ts under bun (createStatsApp + ImmersionTrackerService, retention disabled) and serves stats/dist on PORT (4447). Tools pinned in mise.toml (bun 1.3.5 per packageManager, node 22). Root deps installed with `bun install --production` (electron-builder's tarballs contain 0666 files the sandbox refuses), stats/ deps with `bun install`, UI built with `bun run build` in stats/. Data: .ui-capture/seed/seed.ts replays ~9 months (Feb–Nov 2026) of simulated mpv playback through the tracker's own recording API (handleMediaChange, recordSubtitleLine with tokenized Japanese lines, lookups, Yomitan lookups, cards mined with Anki note ids, pauses, rewinds) using the tracker's test clock hook, then runs its rollup maintenance. ~13 series (Yuru Camp, Non Non Biyori, Kaguya-sama, Hyouka (stalled), Mushishi (dropped), Bocchi the Rock!, SPY x FAMILY (dropped at ep 7), Frieren, Apothecary Diaries, Hibike! Euphonium, Dungeon Meshi (airing, in progress), Dandadan (airing, in progress), plus Terrace House with no poster/metadata). ~170 sessions, ~6k subtitle lines, ~380 vocabulary words, kanji, ~140 mined cards, known-word cache (data/known-words-cache.json). start.sh copies data/immersion.seed.sqlite to data/immersion.sqlite on each start. Main areas: Overview (KPIs, streak calendar, recent sessions), Library (series grid with covers -> series/episode detail), Trends (charts), Vocabulary (words/kanji, known-word coverage, word detail), Sessions (timeline, session detail with mined cards), sentence search. Re-seed: `bun .ui-capture/seed/seed.ts`.
